text.title: Retro Facilitation Multistyle Worked Examples
text.summary: One complete `RetroInstance` for an async Kyiv-Lisbon-London team that ran anonymous-async after sailboat and 4ls, with a note on every non-obvious value, and one bad instance showing what the validator prints and what the facilitator sees beyond it.

section.title: Scenario
section.p: A platform team of nine works from Kyiv, Lisbon (an outsourced pair) and London with no hour everyone can attend live. Two-week sprints; the last two retros were sailboat and 4ls, participation 17 cards and 8 attendees. The previous retro produced two actions: a staging smoke test (Dmytro) and an on-call handover template (Ana), who then spent both weeks on the incident rotation. The PM opens the 2026-05-20 to 05-22 collection window and records the recap on 05-23.

example.title: Retro 2026-05-23, anonymous-async after sailboat and 4ls
example.note: `distribution: async` forces `anonymous-async`; the schema rejects any other format for this team, and `all_participants_on_live_call: false` is why lean-coffee is also out (r-format-matches-distribution).
The rationale names the three timezones, "async", "rotating", "sailboat" and "4ls"; the validator looks for each of those strings (r-rationale-names-distribution-fatigue-and-history).

Rotating: the format only has to differ from 4ls, and it differs from both. Participation rose from 17 to 23 cards, which is what a fresh signal would have needed to justify a repeat (r-fatigued-team-rotates-format).

Safety median 4, so the session stays in its normal mode; had it been 2, `switched_to_anonymous_input` would have to be true. The Lisbon account manager is not a team member and was not in the recap (r-prime-directive-and-safety-check).

Both previous actions carry a status; Ana's is carried over once with a reason and reappears as a new action with a new tracker link and a due date before the next retro. If it is not done on 06-06 it is dropped with a reason, not carried again. `last_run_at` equals `retro_date` because the walk happened today (r-previous-actions-reviewed-before-new-ones).

Two actions, each a named person with a GitHub issue created in the recap and a due date on or before 2026-06-06; the sprint-review slot has no owner yet, so it is a discussion note, not an action (r-action-items-one-to-three-owned-dated-linked).

The window ran Wednesday to Friday, two working days in each of the three timezones, on a form that stores no author; cards were clustered before the recap, nobody was asked who wrote what, and the recorded recap stayed open for comment for one working day (r-anonymous-async-window-and-clustering).
A 60-minute recap for a 14-day sprint sits inside the 45-90 working range and under the 90-minute cap; it took 55, so `overran` is false (r-timebox-published-and-held).

example.title: What the validator and the facilitator reject
example.code: { "retro_date": "2026-05-23", "next_retro_date": "2026-06-06", "iteration_length_days": 14, "format": "mad-sad-glad", "previous_formats": ["mad-sad-glad", "mad-sad-glad"], "selection_rationale": "We always do this one and the team likes it.", "team_state": {"distribution": "async", "fatigue_signal": "fatigued", "timezones": ["Europe/Kyiv", "Europe/Lisbon", "Europe/London"], "all_participants_on_live_call": false}, "participation": {"cards": 6, "attendance": 4}, "opening": { "prime_directive_read": false, "safety_check": {"anonymous": false, "scale": "1-5", "median": 2}, "switched_to_anonymous_input": false, "non_member_manager_in_discussion": true }, "previous_actions_review": [], "action_items": [ {"text": "Fix deploys", "owner": "team", "evidence_link": "https://acme.slack.com/archives/C01/p1", "due_date": "2026-07-15"}, {"text": "Improve communication", "owner": "everyone", "evidence_link": "https://github.com/acme/platform/issues/490", "due_date": "2026-06-30"}, {"text": "Write more tests", "owner": "Dmytro", "evidence_link": "https://github.com/acme/platform/issues/491", "due_date": "2026-06-05"}, {"text": "Update the runbook", "owner": "Ana", "evidence_link": "https://github.com/acme/platform/issues/492", "due_date": "2026-06-05"} ], "timebox": {"published_before_start": false, "minutes": 150, "actual_minutes": 150, "overran": false}, "outcome_review": {"cadence": "next-retro", "last_run_at": "2026-02-14"} }
example.note: Validator output: `$.selection_rationale: matches forbidden 'not' schema`, `$.opening.prime_directive_read: must equal True, got False`, `$.opening.safety_check.anonymous: must equal True, got False`, `$.opening.non_member_manager_in_discussion: must equal False, got True`, `$.opening.switched_to_anonymous_input: must equal True, got False`, `$.action_items: 4 items, maxItems=3`, `$.action_items[0].owner: matches forbidden 'not' schema`, `$.action_items[0].evidence_link: 'https://acme.slack.com/archives/C01/p1' does not match pattern ...`, `$.action_items[1].owner: matches forbidden 'not' schema`, `$.timebox.published_before_start: must equal True, got False`, `$.format: must equal 'anonymous-async', got 'mad-sad-glad'`.

With the distribution corrected to in-person and the schema errors fixed, the cross-field block still reports: `format 'mad-sad-glad' was used in one of the last two retros ['mad-sad-glad', 'mad-sad-glad'] and the team is fatigued (r-fatigued-team-rotates-format)`, `format 'mad-sad-glad' for the third time in a row needs fatigue_signal fresh and participation at or above the previous retro (r-fatigued-team-rotates-format)`, `outcome_review.last_run_at 2026-02-14 must equal retro_date 2026-05-23; the status walk of the previous actions sets it (r-previous-actions-reviewed-before-new-ones)`, `timebox.minutes 150 exceeds 90 for a 14-day iteration (3 hours per month, proportional, 90 for a two-week sprint) (r-timebox-published-and-held)`, and the due dates of 06-30 and 07-15 fall after the 06-06 next retro.

What the facilitator sees beyond the validator: six cards from four people in the London overlap hour, a safety median of 2 with the account manager in the room, the same three columns for the third time, four "actions" nobody in particular owns, and no memory of the two actions agreed in February. This is the retro that produces "we said this last time" for the fourth sprint running.
